name: Regenerate Examples

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: tokf_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    env:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/tokf_test
      RUST_LOG: info

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

        with:
          rust-version: stable
          components: clippy, rustfmt

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Cache cargo git index
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-index-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-index-

      - name: Cache target directory
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-target-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-target-

      - name: Install just
        run: cargo install just

      - name: Install cargo-duplicate
        run: cargo install cargo-duplicate

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: cargo test --workspace

      - name: Run integration tests
        run: just test-db

      - name: Run e2e tests
        run: just test-e2e

      - name: Run clippy
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

      - name: Run fmt check
        run: cargo fmt -- --check

      - name: Run dupes
        run: cargo dupes
